Shortly after the start was hampered when crowded briefly between PHANTOM CYCLONE and SMART CITY which shifted out slightly.
Passing the 250 Metres shifted to the inside of ORIENTAL SURPRISE and a short distance later was steadied when disappointed for that run when ORIENTAL SURPRISE shifted in slightly.
Jumped only fairly.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  In the early stages raced keenly and for some distance leaving the 1400 Metres was steadied from the heels of PHANTOM CYCLONE.  LUCKY GENERATIONS continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages and near the 700 Metres was steadied from the heels of HAILTOTHEVICTORS, resulting in LUCKY GENERATIONS shifting out and making contact with SPANGLE FORTUNE.
No report.
Approaching the 400 Metres was steadied when awkwardly placed on the heels of SPANGLE FORTUNE and as a result was shifted out.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, CONCORDE STAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

E C W Wong reported that after obtaining the lead in the early stages his mount raced keenly and consequently was unable to finish its race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 1500 Metres was eased to avoid the heels of FLOOF which was taken in by ORIENTAL SURPRISE (Apprentice P N Wong).  Apprentice Wong was advised to exercise more care.  Bumped near the 700 Metres.  Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that the instructions were to go forward, but despite riding her mount along in the early stages to obtain a forward position it did not show sufficient pace to do so and as a consequence settled further back in the field than intended.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SPANGLE FORTUNE, which finished tailed out on the second occasion in recent starts, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SPANGLE FORTUNE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  The performance of FLOOF, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FLOOF will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Noted to have shifted its right front plate after the race.

Shortly after the start shifted out slightly and made contact with HAILTOTHEVICTORS.  Leaving the 1400 Metres was briefly tightened when racing in restricted room between FLOOF and MEEPMEEP which shifted out slightly.  Z Purton stated that whilst his mount travelled well throughout the early and middle stages, when he became concerned there may have been something amiss with SMART CITY near the 500 Metres, he elected to ease his mount out of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SMART CITY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART CITY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.

Near the 700 Metres shifted in and made contact with SHINYU KOKOROE.  J Moreira reported that his mount never travelled at any stage of the event and was under continued pressure to maintain its position.  He added despite continuing to urge NO OTHER CHOICE along his mount then failed to run on in the Home Straight.  Trainer C Fownes could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance, however, advised that he would now consider stepping NO OTHER CHOICE up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Badel stated that from his wide barrier he was obliged to settle further back in the field than intended.  He said this, coupled with carrying top weight of 135 lbs, were the principal reasons for NOBLE DELUXE not being able to finish its race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
Near the 700 Metres was tightened for room after being bumped by NO OTHER CHOICE which shifted in.

Making the turn near the 700 Metres NO OTHER CHOICE (J Moreira) shifted in, making contact with SHINYU KOKOROE which was then taken in, resulting in BINGO BABE being crowded and checked when it was also reluctant to hold its position at that stage.  J Moreira was severely reprimanded.  M F Poon stated that his mount never travelled at any stage at the rear of the field and after receiving interference near the 700 Metres failed to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

K Teetan stated that with the early stages of the event being run inside of standard time and his mount dropping back in distance SIGHT DREAMER settled further back in the field than intended.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with the hindquarters of ZETA HEDGE.

When questioned regarding the tactics adopted Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that her instructions were to have the horse ridden in a forward position.  She said on jumping VULCANUS blundered and shifted out abruptly, resulting in her dropping her right rein.  She said as a consequence VULCANUS lost ground and she was obliged to settle at the rear of the field.  When questioned regarding her riding at the 800 Metres Apprentice Yuen stated that she elected to remain racing away from the rail to provide herself with the option of shifting in or out approaching the Home Turn and for this reason she did not improve her position at this stage.  She said approaching the 500 Metres she elected to shift towards the inside of SIGHT DREAMER with a view to obtaining a run between runners in the Home Straight, however, became badly held up for clear running between the 300 Metres and the 100 Metres.  Having regard to the explanation her riding was referred to the Riding Skills Panel for remedial training.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned regarding her riding in the early and middle stages and in particular the fast sectionals she set, Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that her instructions were to settle in a prominent position but not necessarily to lead.  She said after beginning very well and when she was positioned wide on the track making the first turn she rode her mount forward to cross those runners to avoid covering additional ground.  She added near the 1200 Metres she was aware that the tempo she was travelling at was inside standard, however, was reluctant to restrain her mount as she was of the view that it was travelling comfortably.  Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions were to go forward but the preference was to obtain cover.  He stated that, in his opinion, Apprentice Yuen set too fast a tempo on the horse in the middle stages.  The Stewards advised Apprentice Yuen that she should have made a greater effort in the middle stages to set a more sustainable pace and her riding was referred to the Riding Skills Panel for remedial training.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  R Kingscote stated that his mount never travelled at any stage of the event and failed to finish its race off in the Home Straight. Before being allowed to race again, FASHION LEGEND will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

L Hewitson (BULL ATTITUDE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 450 Metres he improved into a run between HINOKAMI KAGURA and SHOTGUN where there was insufficient room to do so, making contact with HINOKAMI KAGURA and consequently then shifted in across the running of SHOTGUN which was checked and lost its rightful running.  L Hewitson was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 24 May 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.  Apprentice P N Wong stated that her mount did not appreciate the kickback and after suffering severe interference near the 450 Metres then gave ground noticeably.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SHOTGUN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SHOTGUN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

She added that due to the manner the horse raced in the early and middle stages it was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Atzeni (GOOD CHAP) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 700 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of FULL OF LAUGHTER, resulting in FULL OF LAUGHTER having to be checked.  A Atzeni was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 10 June 2026 and to expire on Sunday, 14 June 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.
